svg.title: Ripple - larger sizes, 1.0 mm wire
svg.text: All six silhouettes are 1:1. Sizes include wire diameter and exclude attachment hardware.
ACTUAL SIZE / 100% - one page per sheet; no Fit, Shrink or borderless enlargement.
Wire remains 1.00 mm at EVERY size; only the shared curve geometry is enlarged.
Larger sizes open the gaps but do not remove crossings; joint layout and stiffness still need a prototype.
Square: 10.00 x 10.00 mm between line centers.
Measure BOTH axes. Screen size and printer scaling are not reliable rulers.
Cold-forming guide only. Do not solder on paper. Bail, joint design and allowances are not included.
